# substitution2
## Challenge Overview
It seems that another encrypted message has been intercepted. The encryptor seems to have learned their lesson though and now there isn't any punctuation! Can you still crack the cipher?

<img width="990" height="708" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/285895d8-ac84-4dc1-b7ce-8a0cbe3d6cf4" />

## Solutions
The message provided by the chall:
```bash
{G6D4U_4G41T515_15_73Y10A5_42JX1770}
```

To solve this challenge, I'm also using [this](https://www.guballa.de/substitution-solver) online tools to decrypt the message.

Output:
```bash
{N6R4M_4N41Y515_15_73D10U5_42EA1770}
```

Flag: `picoCTF{N6R4M_4N41Y515_15_73D10U5_42EA1770}`
